name: cavemio-faq-accordion
title: FAQ accordion
description: Questions on fine lines that open like they mean it: the answer eases to its height, the plus folds into a minus.

cavemio.accessibility:
- Each question is a heading with a button (aria-expanded, aria-controls); each answer is a labelled region, hidden from the tab order when closed.
- Up and Down move between questions, Home and End jump to the first and last, as the ARIA accordion pattern describes.
- Height is animated with grid rows, so answers can be any length without measuring.
- With reduced motion, answers open and close in place.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

features.title: It opens to the real height
features.description: The answer eases open to its own height, whatever its length, without measuring it first.

features.title: It closes without squeezing
features.description: The words fade first and then the space closes, so the text is never crushed.

features.title: One at a time, or many
features.description: In single mode, opening one question closes the other in the same motion. Choose which start open.

features.title: Answers can be anything
features.description: Text, links, lists or small tables. An answer is any React.

features.title: Keyboard navigation
features.description: Up and Down move between questions, and Home and End jump to the first and last.

features.title: Correct markup
features.description: Each question is a heading with a button that has aria-expanded, and closed answers are out of the tab order.

states.title: closed
states.description: The question at 80% ink on a thin line, with a plus; hover brings it to full.

states.title: opening
states.description: The answer’s row grows to its real height (460ms) and its text rises 6px out of a 4px blur; the plus turns 180° into a minus.

states.title: closing
states.description: The words fade in 160ms, then the space closes, so text never gets squeezed.

states.title: single / multiple
states.description: One open at a time, or any number.
